newsitem.title: ITALY: France Telecom to take 49 pct of Infostrada.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom to take 49 pct of Infostrada.

text.p: Olivetti and France Telecom said in a statement they signed a joint venture deal under which the French group would acquire 49 percent of Infostrada, a telecoms company.
The statement said France Telecom would acquire the shareholding by subscribing to a 165 billion lire capital increase.
The balance of Infostrada would be held by Olivetti and Bell Atlantic through a newly-created holding company called Infoinvestment.
Olivetti Managing Director Roberto Colaninno said the agreement was a key step in the group's strategy of developing its telecommunications interests.
"This initiative is a decisive step in Olivetti's strategy to become a global operator in telephony and in telecommunications services," he said.

France Telecom President Michel Bon said "this enables us to strengthen our international presence and we are certain that Infostrada will make even more dynamic the telecommunications market in Italy."
France Telecom has designated Georges Leperchey, currently director of its telecoms network in Ile de France, to be Director General of Infostrada.
Marco De Benedetti remains President of the group and Riccardo Ruggiero its Managing Director. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
